meta.title: Fanout AI — One idea. Five formats.
meta.description: Turn one idea into a blog post, LinkedIn post, Instagram caption, email newsletter and X thread — streamed at once.

home.lead: Give Fanout one idea and get five ready-to-publish pieces, streamed side by side.
home.note: Accounts and guest sessions work today. The generator, library and publishing are being built phase by phase.

notFound.title: This page fanned out into nothing.
notFound.description: The link may be broken, or the page may have moved. Head back and try again.

error.title: Something went wrong.
error.description: An unexpected error interrupted this page. Trying again usually fixes it.

globalError.title: Fanout AI hit a snag.
globalError.description: The app failed to load. Trying again usually fixes it — your saved content is safe.

wakingUp.title: Demo is waking up
wakingUp.description: This demo runs on a free database that goes to sleep when nobody visits. Hang tight — it is usually back within a minute.
wakingUp.nextCheck: Checking again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
wakingUp.stillDown: Still asleep. A free-tier database pauses after a week without visitors and then has to be restarted by the owner. Please come back a little later.

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Log in to your Fanout workspace.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: Free plan: 5 generations a month, five formats each. No card needed.

guest.title: Try Fanout as a guest
guest.description: No email, no password. You can turn the guest session into a real account later and keep everything you made.
guest.footer: Rather have an account? <signup>Sign up free</signup> or <login>log in</login>

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.description: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.

updatePassword.title: Set a password
updatePassword.description: Choose a password for your account. You'll use it with your email to log in.

upgrade.title: Create your account
upgrade.description: Everything you made as a guest stays in your library. You'll move to the Free plan: 5 generations a month, plus publishing.
upgrade.footer: Already have an account? <link>Log in</link> instead — the guest session's content will not be moved.

notConfigured.description: This deployment has no Supabase project connected. Add the Supabase keys to the environment (see .env.example) and restart.
